resources.string: This practicum introduces the fundamentals of Android application development with Kotlin and XML layouts. Each meeting adds one topic, from the first Hello, World! app to tab layouts, menus, and custom styles. The course is part of the Software Engineering Technology program, Vocational School, Universitas Gadjah Mada.
